business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Catalog Retail of Industrial Maintenance Hardware

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system combining English common law and French civil law, with applicable customary law (kastom) recognized where not inconsistent; unitary national corporate and tax legislation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty between the Republic of Vanuatu and the People's Republic of China on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 2003, in force 2004)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force 2020 (trade and investment liberalization with Australia, New Zealand and Pacific Forum states)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and Australia (in force 2010)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and New Zealand (in force 2011)
Vanuatu accession to the World Trade Organization (2012) and related trade commitments applicable to electronic commerce and cross-border services

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of 1992, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2022 (mandatory beneficial-ownership records); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2021 (Act No. 10 of 2021) together with the AML/CFT Regulations 2021; Financial Services Commission Act 2011 (establishing the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission as registrar and AML/CFT supervisor); Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit AML/CFT directives and guidance; obligations under the FATF Recommendations as implemented for the International Company tax-exempt regime
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (private beneficial-ownership register maintained by the VFSC-licensed registered agent; lawful access by the VFSC, Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, Reserve Bank of Vanuatu and other designated competent authorities; not publicly searchable; nominee shareholders permitted but underlying beneficial owners must be identified to the registered agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the biometric page of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner, director, secretary and authorised signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner of Oaths in the country of origin or residence of the relevant individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the original state; where the origin state is not party to the Hague Apostille Convention, consular legalisation through the nearest Vanuatu diplomatic mission or accredited honorary consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder or corporate beneficial owner holding 25% or more of VU_IC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or equivalent competent authority of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Apostille jurisdictions, consular legalisation through the competent Vanuatu consular channel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration Form and AML/CFT Due Diligence Questionnaire completed by each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu, executed by the ultimate beneficial owner or duly authorised attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarisation of the signatory's execution before a notary public; Hague Apostille required where executed outside Vanuatu and the execution state is an Apostille Party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Irrevocable Power of Attorney authorising the VFSC-licensed registered agent and counsel to effect incorporation, name reservation and regulatory filings for VU_IC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner or its board of directors, as applicable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarisation plus Hague Apostille or consular legalisation in the jurisdiction of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and professional introduction letter for each ultimate beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution maintaining a deposit relationship with the relevant individual or entity in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Authentication verified by the issuing bank's authorised officer and legalised by apostille or consular legalisation as required by Bathe registered agent's internal AML policy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening of all ultimate beneficial owners, directors, secretary, authorised signatories and commercial counterparties against (i) the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit politically exposed persons (PEP) register and domestic refusal/disqualification records; (ii) the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (iii) the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and other sanctions lists; (iv) the EU CFSP consolidated sanctions list; (v) Australian DFAT and UK HMRC consolidated sanctions lists; and (vi) adverse-media and enforcement-action databases. A positive PEP or sanctions hit requires escalation to the registered agent's compliance officer and, for PEPs, mandatory senior-management approval, enhanced due diligence covering source of wealth, source of funds and continued monitoring under the AML/CFT Act 2021. Screening results must be date-stamped and preserved in the client due-diligence file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry - Name Reservation and Online Registry Search (Port Vila; official website vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be in Latin script using English or French, the official legislative languages of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. Bislama-only names are not accepted as the sole registered name. Foreign-language names and transliterations are permissible only when romanised, accompanied by a verified English or French translation, and where the name is not misleadingly similar to any existing Vanuatu registered name. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Corporation', 'Corp' or an acceptable French equivalent; the use of a different script on ancillary trade documents does not alter the registered statutory name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name-rejection notice, the applicant may file a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the refusal, stating the legal grounds and attaching supporting evidence; the VFSC must determine the reconsideration within 15 working days. If reconsideration is unsuccessful, the applicant may commence judicial-review proceedings in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 28 days of the final refusal notice. A name reservation that has not been used for incorporation lapses on the 30th day; the applicant may request one extension of up to 30 days before expiry by filing VFSC Form NR-X and paying the applicable extension fee. In parallel, the applicant may submit ranked alternative names so that no incorporation delay occurs.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only in the form of a service-office arrangement maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent at a physical street address in Port Vila; a PO Box alone is statutorily unacceptable as the registered office. The virtual office may serve as the statutory registered office and correspondence hub for the B2B MRO catalogue e-commerce entity. Because VU_IC is an exempt International Company, it may not carry on domestic business with Vanuatu residents or maintain a physical retail or operational storefront in Vanuatu; the entity must confine its activities to offshore/remote electronic catalogue sales of industrial maintenance hardware via credit-card and SWIFT rails.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% estimated annual probability for the Low_Risk_Standard industrial MRO B2B e-commerce category). The VFSC and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit retain statutory, risk-based powers to conduct unannounced physical inspections, primarily at the registered agent's premises, and to demand immediate production of the beneficial-ownership register and client due-diligence files. The inspection likelihood would increase if credit-card acquiring or SWIFT transaction patterns generate banking-AML alerts, if adverse screening hits are detected, or if the registered agent is selected for a VFSC targeted supervisory cycle.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended), Part II ss. 4-12 (incorporation and certificate of registration), ss. 13-14 (registered office and registered agent), ss. 21-25 (directors, secretary and first appointments), and the Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 where applicable
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued or paid-up capital; share capital may be expressed in USD or any foreign currency and the shares may remain wholly unpaid at registration; no escrow account or capital deposit is required by the VFSC at incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that subscribers identified in the register of members be confirmed as first shareholders, and that one ordinary share of USD 1.00 be allotted to each subscriber, credited as fully paid without additional capital contribution. RESOLVED, that the registered office at the licensed agent's address in Port Vila, Vanuatu be adopted as the Company's statutory seat and address for service, and that the registered agent be authorized to file notice thereof with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED, that one Director, one Secretary, and one Chief Financial Officer be appointed as first officers of the Company, authorized severally to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and effect all regulatory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Corporate and International Services Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the VFSC e-Services portal and submit a name reservation application for the proposed International Company. Provide three ranked name proposals, all containing 'Limited' or 'Ltd' where required, for checking against the register of existing or prohibited names. The application may be lodged directly online or through a licensed registered agent.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of beneficial owner passport
Registered agent engagement letter referencing the proposed entity name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is refused for similarity or unacceptable character, the second or third ranked name is automatically considered; otherwise, a fresh reservation may be submitted within 5 business days with a revision letter addressing the Registrar's reason.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent approved by VFSC (submitting on behalf of subscribers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English in conformity with the International Companies Act standard form. Subscribers execute the charter before a notary public or the registered agent's in-house witness where permitted; affix notarization or apostille/consular legalization where the signatory is outside Vanuatu. Submit the executed set to the agent for e-lodgment.
required_dossiers: Consents to act as director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where VFSC flags defects in execution or language, the agent issues a deficiency notice; re-execution and re-notarization must be completed within 10 business days, with clear annotation of amendments to avoid duplicate filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form IC-1 together with the executed constitutional documents and the agent's certificate of compliance through the VFSC e-Lodgment interface, or physically at the VFSC counter in Port Vila. Pay the USD 300 government filing fee and applicable stamp duty by wire transfer or nominated bank; attach the payment receipt to the submission dossier.
required_dossiers: Agent certificate of compliance with the International Companies Act
Government fee and stamp duty payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application receives a query or is rejected, the registered agent files a written response addressing each query item within 14 calendar days; no additional government fee is levied for the first resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Posting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique IC number and the date of incorporation. Verify the certificate particulars against the application, and have the registered agent record the registered office at Port Vila in the public register.
required_dossiers: Board register of members and officers (first entries)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any clerical error in the Certificate is rectified by a statutory declaration and reissuance request to the Registrar, normally completed within 5 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Onboarding and Banking Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent; commercial banks licensed by the Vanuatu Reserve Bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt the first written resolution to allot shares, adopt the registered office, and appoint directors and officers, as reflected in the minutes. Open the company's bank account with a licensed bank using the corporate dossier and intended Swift-wire/credit-card merchant rails; register for the VFSC e-services and beneficial ownership platform; file any economic substance declaration if trading activities later create physical presence.
required_dossiers: Corporate bank account application form and source of funds statement
Registered agent's certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or platform requests additional due diligence, provide an updated corporate chart, ultimate beneficial owner declaration, and evidence of intended B2B MRO transactions; any rejection can be addressed through the agent's relationship manager and the Vanuatu Bankers' Association review process.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry — Ministry of Trade, Industry and Tourism (industrial licensing); not applicable to offshore electronic catalog retail anywhere in Vanuatu. Industrial licensing would arise only if the entity later operates a physical warehouse, assembly, or manufacturing facility within Vanuatu.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license is mandated for the B2B MRO e-commerce model. International Companies transacting exclusively outside Vanuatu are exempt from the Business Licence Act [Cap. 227]; a local Business Licence would be triggered only upon physical storage, local employment, or domestic sales.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no EIA report or registration required for catalog e-commerce with no construction, land disturbance, or manufacturing; a Category B environmental registration would only be triggered by a future bonded warehouse or logistics depot.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge streams exist at formation stage. Future warehousing must comply with the Waste Management Regulations and the Environmental Protection Act [Cap. 283], including wastewater discharge permits, VOC-free packaging declarations, and hazardous waste handling under Basel Convention procedures.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Any staffed registered office in Port Vila must obtain: (i) a Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service covering detectors, extinguishers, and egress; (ii) an Occupational Health and Safety certificate from the Department of Labour for the office premises; (iii) no structural load inspection is required unless storage racking exceeds 2.5 meters, in which case a Public Works Department building permit is mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official online portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is not automatically issued a general TIN. Upon incorporation, the VFSC assigns a company registration number; the IC's income-tax exemption is automatic and does not require a taxpayer ID. If the IC conducts a taxable activity in or from Vanuatu and meets or elects VAT registration, it must submit the prescribed VAT Application for Registration to the Commissioner of Inland Revenue, attaching the VFSC certificate of incorporation, registered-office consent, business licence, proposed supply details and identity documents of directors and owners. The Commissioner then issues a VAT Registration Number, which serves as the tax ID for VAT purposes. Non-VAT-registered International Companies are not assigned a TIN, and no annual income-tax registration or filing obligation arises.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime. The International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu direct taxes under the International Companies Act and cannot elect to be ordinarily taxable, pass-through, disregarded, or treated as a tax resident for income-tax purposes. The only relevant election is voluntary VAT registration below the compulsory threshold; a registered IC may also make statutory VAT elections, including zero-rating of exports and recovery of input VAT, under the Value Added Tax Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act (VAT Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration applies to a supplier whose taxable supplies in any 12-month period reach or exceed Vatu 5,000,000 (VT 5,000,000). Voluntary registration is available below the threshold. Zero-rated exports count as taxable supplies for threshold measurement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, tax-authority API clearance, or digital fiscal stamping regime is in force. VAT tax invoices must contain the statutory particulars and be issued within the timeline required by the VAT Act. Customs export declarations must be lodged electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs clearance system; an approved electronic export declaration and clearance reference is required to support the zero-rated export and any input VAT refund.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply of industrial MRO goods qualifies for the 0% rate where the buyer is a non-resident, title and risk pass outside Vanuatu, the physical goods are exported from Vanuatu to the destination country within the required period, and the supplier holds contemporaneous export evidence. Certain offshore services, international freight, and services directly related to exported goods also qualify. The zero-rating benefit is lost if goods are diverted to the local Vanuatu market or the exporter fails to maintain proof of export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (approved ASYCUDA World outward declaration showing exporter, consignee, HS code, quantity, value and departure date)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment from Vanuatu to the destination country
Commercial invoice, packing list, and purchase order or export contract evidencing the international sale at 0% VAT
Inward Remittance Certificate, SWIFT MT103, or credit-card settlement record evidencing payment by the non-resident customer
VAT zero-rated tax invoice issued by the exporter to the customer
Copy of the International Company incorporation or VFSC registration and, if registered, the VAT registration certificate
Evidence of delivery or order fulfilment from the MRO e-commerce platform, including final tracking status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner may retrospectively reassess a purported export as a domestic taxable supply at 12.5% and claw back refunds or input credits if export documentation is missing, inconsistent, or goods are diverted into Vanuatu. Penalties include default and penalty tax on the unpaid VAT amount, recovery of overclaimed refunds, and prosecution for fraudulent evasion or knowingly false zero-rating declarations under the VAT Act. On conviction, substantial fines of up to VT 5,000,000 and imprisonment of responsible persons may be imposed, in addition to director liability and loss of zero-rating or export certification. Export substantiation records and FX remittance evidence should be retained for at least 5 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], is the sole monetary and exchange control authority for the Vatu (VUV), acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 96] and the Exchange Control Regulations. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the regulatory authority for International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and serves as the AML/CFT supervisor for financial institutions other than banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV is freely convertible for current account transactions, trade in goods and services, and remittance of profits to non-residents without quantitative restriction or prior RBV approval. Capital account operations by resident entities are subject to exchange control authorisation, but the target International Company is statutorily exempt: Section 32 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] disapplies the Exchange Control Act to International Companies and their operations. Consequently, the IC may hold, convert, and transfer USD, AUD, EUR, and NZD balances without RBV consent, and profit distribution is wholly free of Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and exchange control gateways. Practical hurdles are limited to correspondent bank due diligence and UBO transparency requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the general Exchange Control Act [Cap. 96] regime applicable to Vanuatu resident exporters, export proceeds must be received within six months of the date of shipment and surrendered to a RBV-authorised dealer within one month of receipt, with a mandatory conversion ratio of 100% of eligible foreign currency denominated export earnings unless a specific exemption is granted. Critical carve-out: International Companies are outside the scope of the Exchange Control Act by virtue of Section 32 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; therefore the IC is not subject to any statutory surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio and may retain export receivables indefinitely in foreign currency accounts onshore or offshore.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility as a supplemental collection and pay-out rail, but not as a substitute for an onshore RBV-regulated bank account. Vanuatu has no EMI or digital banking licensing framework; VFSC does not issue EMI licences. The IC may commercially use reputable overseas EMIs (e.g., FCA- or MAS-authorised) for USD/AUD settlement to end-customers, subject to strict correspondent due diligence, sanctions screening, and the EMIs own risk appetite toward Vanuatu-incorporated entities. Regulatory comfort is limited and many EMIs will decline onboarding until the IC has established a track record with a Tier 1 Vanuatu bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory rule mandates physical presence, but de facto bank policy at ANZ and BSP requires at least the primary director and authorised signatories to attend an in-person KYC interview in Port Vila, or to complete a notarised/officialised remote onboarding with a video-linked interview conducted by the bank's compliance officer plus an introduction from a recognised regulated intermediary. The registered agent under the International Companies Act may facilitate, but cannot waive, the bank's know-your-customer interviews for non-resident beneficial owners. Remote-only onboarding is available on a case-by-case basis only for low-risk, cash-neutral holding structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore non-resident ownership with zero evident local operational substance or physical office
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certified certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing; registered agent letter confirming compliance with the International Companies Act; notarised board resolution appointing signatories; register of directors and ultimate beneficial owners with passports and proof of address; group structure chart; three years of shareholder financial statements or bank reference letters; and a written substance statement describing the e-commerce operating model and registered office arrangements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Heightened jurisdictional risk flags arising from Vanuatu FATF/EU listings and perceived offshore secrecy
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC good-standing certificates; Natsco company registry extract; full AML/CFT compliance manual adopted under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (Act No. 2 of 2020); appointment letter of the Money Laundering Reporting Officer; evidence of staff AML/CFT training; and an engagement contract with a RBV-supervised and VFSC-licensed corporate services provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity B2B e-commerce receipts from multiple overseas buyers with low average ticket sizes inconsistent with classic wholesale trade
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented buyer KYC/onboarding records containing legal entity identification, jurisdiction, and sanctions screening results; sample commercial invoices and purchase orders referencing ISIC 4791 industrial MRO supplies; transaction surveillance program parameters; and a written narrative reconciling sales velocity to the electronic catalog business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border disbursements to unrelated third-party MRO suppliers and freight forwarders through SWIFT and LC channels
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier KYC file with registered address, bank details, and beneficial ownership; signed distribution or procurement agreements; purchase orders referencing ISIC 4791 product lines; transport documents (bill of lading, airway bill) or freight invoices; and a reconciliation trail tying supplier payments to confirmed customer orders.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity contributions are routed by SWIFT MT103/MT103 GPI from the shareholder's account to the IC's designated USD account at an RBV-authorised dealer bank in Vanuatu. The wire field 50/remittance information must state 'equity injection / share capital contribution under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]' using ISO purpose code 'CAPT' (Capital) or legacy purpose code 'K', accompanied by the latest certificate of incumbency, a certified board resolution authorising issue and allotment of shares, and written confirmation from the registered agent for VFSC filing. The receiving bank will verify standard settlement instructions (SSI), affirm the exchange-control exemption, perform positive-match UBO and sanctions screening, and credit the funds only after the corporate packet is complete; no RBV consent is required for the International Company to receive capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed through (i) SWIFT MT103/MT103 GPI priority wires for high-volume, low-value MRO purchases and freight disbursements; (ii) commercial documentary letters of credit (sight or usance, on CFR/CIF terms) issued via MT700 and covered by MT202/MT103 cover payments through the bank's global correspondent network for large supplier framework contracts; and (iii) domestic payments to Vanuatu suppliers via the RBV-operated interbank payment and settlement systems to the extent onshore vendors are engaged. All outbound instructions require a logged commercial invoice, supplier KYC reference, and sanctions screen; funds are settled in the invoice currency without exchange-control approval given the IC statutory exemption.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts (USD/AUD/EUR versus VUV) booked with ANZ, BSP, or Bred Bank as RBV-authorised dealers, relying on the International Company exchange-control exemption
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV/USD executed with international counterparty banks, cash-settled in USD outside Vanuatu without restriction
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/AUD) with licensed bank counterparties to hedge multi-currency MRO procurement and supplier liabilities
FX swap and swap-deposit arrangements with Vanuatu Tier 1 banks for short-term liquidity management and interest rate optimisation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (International Company Annual Levy)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of the certificate of incorporation; initial fee prepaid at incorporation, subsequent fees due on the same calendar anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee applied after 30 days; additional VUV interest per month thereafter; administrative strike-off proceedings begin after 90 days of non-payment, with final strike-off restoring assets to the Government of Vanuatu

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation, or within 14 days of any share ownership or control change, whichever occurs first; the registered agent must verify and confirm the register of beneficial owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or maintain an up-to-date beneficial ownership register carries a penalty of up to VUV 500,000 (approx. USD 4,320) and potential director disqualification; continued non-compliance may result in administrative dissolution under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2020

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a standard non-licensed International Company engaged in passive e-commerce or MRO catalog sales. Audit becomes compulsory only if the company holds a VFSC financial services license (e.g., banking, insurance, securities) or if the Board of Directors or shareholders adopt a resolution requiring an independent audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act (Cap 222) does not prescribe a specific accounting framework. Books and records may be maintained in any reputable format; IFRS or US GAAP is commonly adopted voluntarily for internal management and banking accommodation. No local GAAP applies to tax-exempt offshore ICs.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2020, the registered agent is required to identify all beneficial owners. A shareholder transfer or any change in the natural-person beneficial owner must be evidenced by a written disclosure to the registered agent within 14 days. The agent must then update the Register of Members and the Beneficial Ownership Register and file an annual confirmation with the VFSC on the company's anniversary date, verifying that the registered details are accurate. The confirmation is not publicly accessible but is subject to inspection by competent authorities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members - maintained at the registered office, showing all shareholdings, transfers, and beneficial ownership references
Register of Directors - maintained at the registered office, including full names, residential addresses, and dates of appointment
Register of Charges - if any secured borrowings exist, a register of charges and liens
Minute Book - records of director and shareholder resolutions, kept in original or electronic form

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – USD 1,000 (standard Vanuatu registered agent and registered office inclusive of annual compliance administration)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for a standard IC; if voluntary audit is selected, typical fee ranges from USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 depending on transaction volume and record completeness

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, and no withholding tax. An International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) holds an express statutory exemption from all present and future taxes. The only government impost is the annual Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) license fee of approximately VUV 10,000 to VUV 37,000 depending on authorized share capital.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return and License Fee Payment (Form IC-AR); filed by the licensed registered agent through the VFSC Company Registry electronic filing system. No corporate income tax return exists because no income tax is assessable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the last day of the month containing the anniversary of incorporation; payment must clear by that date to avoid late surcharges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and VFSC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial owners are not listed on this public form; they are filed separately on the confidential VFSC beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 2 - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address in Vanuatu and the managing registered agent's license details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A P.O. Box is not acceptable; the agent must hold a current VFSC license.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 3 - Authorized and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, issued shares, par value or no-par-value designation, and total stated capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Full non-resident ownership is permitted without exchange control approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, service addresses, nationality, and appointment dates of each director and of the secretary if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be natural persons or bodies corporate; Vanuatu residency is not required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC transacted no business with or within Vanuatu during the preceding year and that accounting records are maintained at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: B2B MRO e-commerce sales to Vanuatu-resident end-users are prohibited; sales to non-residents are lawful.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the registered agent that customer due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and risk rating of the beneficial owner are complete and current.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent may require evidence of the corporate credit-card and SWIFT payment trail before attesting.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment surcharge of 10% of the annual fee for the first month and 2% per month thereafter; continuing default beyond 12 months triggers automatic striking-off of the IC, forfeiture of the company's assets, and disqualification of the registered agent.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax treaty in force and imposes no dividend withholding tax; therefore no treaty-relief filing or Vanuatu tax residency certificate is required. A foreign corporate parent is advised to obtain a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing showing the IC's exempt status and to attach the underlying dividend resolution and IC Act exemption provision when claiming foreign tax credit in the parent's residence state.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on outbound royalties (patent, trademark, know-how) and 0% on debt interest to related or unrelated lenders; no treaty rate reduction is applicable because no DTA exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Vanuatu transfer-pricing statute prescribes a threshold; no Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country Report is payable or filed in Vanuatu. The IC must nonetheless keep at the registered office sufficient accounting records to evidence that MRO resale margins and intercompany service fees are established at arm's length.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP - comparable uncontrolled benchmark of the MRO catalogue resale markup against independent distributors
Resale Price Method - applied to buy-and-resell MRO distribution functions
Cost Plus Method - applied to contract-fulfillment and logistics support
TNMM - net margin benchmark of the simple e-commerce distribution risk profile
Profit Split Method - reserved for integrated supply-chain arrangements with the manufacturing affiliate
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not administer a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations filing regime for standard International Companies, but the IC Act imposes substantive territorial constraints: a registered office in Vanuatu, books and records physically present in Vanuatu, and prohibition of any trade with Vanuatu residents. The MRO e-commerce contracting, invoicing, and payment flows must therefore be positioned offshore. If the IC incidentally derives Vanuatu-source revenue or IP-related income, it forfeits the exempt treatment and becomes exposed to VAT at 12.5% and to potential income tax should any future direct-tax law be enacted.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Exemption Abuse / Domestic Trade Under IC Cover
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An International Company sells industrial MRO supplies to Vanuatu-resident customers, maintains warehouse inventory in Vanuatu, or holds leasehold industrial premises, while continuing to claim the zero-tax IC exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic loss of exempt status; the Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue assesses VAT at 12.5% on undeclared Vanuatu sales, plus a recovery penalty of up to 150% of the tax due and statutory interest compounding daily.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized the prohibited domestic trade are jointly and severally liable for the assessed VAT, penalties, and interest; the court may issue travel bans, freezing orders over personal assets, and disqualification under the International Companies Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Masking / Beneficial Ownership Non-Disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealment of the natural-person controllers of the MRO e-commerce IC through nominee shareholders or multi-layer offshore entities, or failure to update the VFSC beneficial ownership register within 14 days of a change of control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 per infraction plus mandatory striking-off proceedings; intentional concealment also constitutes a predicate offense under the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act and carries imprisonment of up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director is personally liable for the VUV 1,000,000 fine; courts routinely issue departure-prohibition orders preventing directors from leaving Vanuatu while the fine is unpaid, and nominee directors face criminal sentencing equal to that of a natural-person beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach in Trade Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing MRO e-commerce receipts through private non-corporate credit cards or using the IC as a pass-through settlement vehicle for third-party goods, thereby circumventing the registered agent's obligational customer due diligence under the AML/CFT Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to VUV 30,000,000 per violation, freezing of corporate bank accounts and the e-commerce payment gateway, and administrative strike-off of the IC with consequential nullity of outstanding purchase orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly structured payment flows to avoid VFSC-discipline are personally liable to fines of up to VUV 30,000,000 and imprisonment for up to 15 years; laundered corporate assets are recoverable from the directors' personal estates, and travel bans apply pending confiscation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Intercompany Margin Manipulation / Implied Transfer-Pricing Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing of MRO goods from the related manufacturing affiliate so high, or downstream resale so low, that the Vanuatu e-commerce IC books zero or negative margin while the foreign affiliate absorbs the residual profit, without retaining any arm's length benchmark documentation in the Vanuatu registered-office records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no domestic TP adjustment provision, but the VFSC substance review and the automatic exchange of information under the multilateral transparency framework will flag the margin imbalance to the controllers' home tax authority; the foreign authority may apply secondary adjustments of up to 100% of the underpaid tax, plus late-payment interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve a zero-margin intercompany structure knowing that a foreign tax benefit is the driver become exposed to foreign-jurisdiction director liability, including civil tax-evasion judgments enforceable against the IC's assets under the Reciprocal Enforcement of Judgments Act, travel bans in the home jurisdiction, and imprisonment of up to 7 years for tax fraud.
